composer.dropOverlayHint: Folder paths are hidden by the browser when you drop a directory—use the folder button. If a file path is hidden, we copy once to ~/.ttt/drops (local only).
composer.attachFileTitle: Insert local file path (opens a file picker; the file is not uploaded)
composer.attachFolderTitle: Insert local folder path (opens a folder picker; nothing is uploaded)
composer.folderDropTitle: Why folder drag does not work here
composer.folderDropBody:
Web browsers deliberately do not expose the real folder path on your disk when you drop a directory—they only give access to files inside it, without a full path (this is a security rule).

When the OS includes a file:// link with the drop (some setups do), we use that automatically. Otherwise use the folder button to open your system's folder picker, or drop a single file—we can stage a copy under ~/.ttt/drops if the path is hidden.
composer.multiFileDropBody: Drop a single file so we can read or stage its path. For an entire folder path, use the folder button instead.
composer.fileTooLargeBody: This file is over the 2 GB staging limit. Pick a smaller file or use a file:// path when the browser provides one.
composer.stageFailUnexpectedBody: An unexpected error occurred while saving to ~/.ttt/drops.
composer.pickerUnavailableBody: Local file and folder pickers are not supported on this platform.
